findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee fail to use a barrier to turn off the hand sink. Ensure staff are using the provided paper towels to turn off the hand sink to avoid cross-contamination. An employee was also observed using their clothing to dry their hands after washing. Clothing poses a cross-contamination risk and therefore cannot be used for drying.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the hand sink in the bakery area to be obstructed. PIC was informed that hand sinks need to be accessible at all times to promote proper hand washing. The hand sink obstruction was removed during the inpsection.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the sanitizer bucket next to the drive-thru window to have 50ppm quaternary ammonia. The PIC was informed that the concentration was too low, and the sanitizer bucket was replaced. Sanitizer concentrations will decrease over time with use and evaporation. Therefore, the sanitizer buckets need to be replaced frequently to ensure proper concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Observed multiple large storage containers holding white powders to be unlabeled. PIC was informed that labels need to be placed on containers to allow for recognition of container contents. Ensure containers are labeled by next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.12 Food Storage Containers, Identified with Common Name of Food. Except for containers holding FOOD that can be readily and unmistakably recognized such as dry pasta, working containers holding FOOD or FOOD ingredients that are removed from their original packages for use in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, such as cooking oils, flour, herbs, potato flakes, salt, spices, and sugar shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the shelves of the syrup dispensers to have a heavy accumulation of syrup and dust. PIC stated that the dispensers are cleaned every Thursday. PIC was advised that cleaning frequency may need to be increased to avoid the accumulation of soil and debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed employee food items stored on upper shelving of cooler above food for the consumer. PIC was advised that a designated storage area should be assigned below food for consumers to avoid cross-contamination. Ensure designated areas are assigned and in use prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed employee pour syrup down drain of kitchen hand sink. Advised employee that hand washing sinks may only be used for hand washing purposes. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitizing solution available for use during food preparation and service. Sanitizing solution was made during inspection, and tested at 200 ppm quaternary ammonia. 

4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed containers used to store clean cooking utensils to be soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize containers used to store clean cooking utensils. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.
